currency.description: The foreign currency, as an ISO 4217 code; never the base currency.

kind.description: day: the rate for one day, which overrides the daily feed's on that date and replaces the organisation's earlier rate for it; month: a rate of the monthly table, used for a date with neither (ENG-40).

note.description: Where the rate came from, such as the bank's board rate.

on.description: The day; for a month, the month's first day.

quote.description: The rate as the source quotes it, a decimal string of up to 10 decimal places (ENG-12, ENG-44).

quote_form.description: How the quote is given: base currency per one unit (stored as it is), per 100 units, or foreign currency per one unit of the base. Fyniq stores base per one unit under RND-RATE: round(quote ÷ 100, 10) or round(1 ÷ quote, 10), half away from zero.
